title: VeriVoice
shortDescription: An intelligent multi-agent voice platform designed to automate business conversations and workflows.
fullDescription: VeriVoice is an intelligent voice automation platform that enables businesses to deploy specialised AI agents for customer conversations, qualification and task execution. Rather than one general-purpose bot, each agent owns a narrow remit — reception, qualification, booking, follow-up — and hands off to the next with full context. Every call is transcribed, scored and written back to the customer's CRM, and any caller can reach a human by asking.

challenge.summary: The client was losing qualified enquiries outside office hours and burning senior time on calls that never needed a specialist. Earlier voice bots had been abandoned because callers found them slow and evasive.
points: Roughly a third of inbound calls arrived outside staffed hours and went to voicemail, where most were never returned.
Previous systems had latency long enough that callers spoke over the agent and the conversation collapsed.
Call outcomes were logged manually and inconsistently, so pipeline data could not be trusted.
Any automated system had to hand over to a person instantly on request, without the caller repeating themselves.

solution.summary: We built a multi-agent architecture where each agent has one job, a small set of tools and an explicit escalation path — then optimised the audio pipeline until conversations felt natural.
points: Split the conversation into discrete agent roles with typed handoff contracts carrying full context.
Streamed speech recognition and synthesis end to end, with barge-in detection so callers can interrupt naturally.
Gave each agent narrow, permissioned tool access — calendar, CRM, knowledge base — rather than open-ended system control.
Built an evaluation suite of recorded scenarios so prompt and model changes are measured against regressions before release.
Wrote structured outcomes back to the CRM on every call, removing manual logging entirely.

workflow.title: Call received
workflow.description: Twilio routes the call into the platform and opens a bidirectional audio stream.

workflow.title: Reception agent
workflow.description: Identifies the caller, establishes intent and selects the specialist agent to hand to.

workflow.title: Specialist agent
workflow.description: Runs its objective — qualification, booking or support — using its permitted tools.

workflow.title: System actions
workflow.description: Calendar slots are held, CRM records created and confirmations dispatched mid-call.

workflow.title: Outcome & handoff
workflow.description: Transcript, outcome and recording are written back, or the caller is warm-transferred to a person.
